# KOVO-KUKY: complete profile

> Family-owned contract CNC machining shop in Dolní Bukovsko, South Bohemia, Czech Republic. Turning, 3-axis milling and cutting of metals and technical plastics for customers in the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria and Slovakia.

## Company
- Name: KOVO-KUKY (Václav Kukačka, sole proprietor)
- In business since 1990, run by the second generation since around 2000
- Address: Veselská 58, 373 65 Dolní Bukovsko, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
- IČO: 721 80 714, DIČ / VAT: CZ8011251237
- Team: 6 people
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 07:00 to 16:00 (Central European Time)
- Contact: info@kovokuky.cz, +420 725 770 820, https://www.kovokuky.cz
- Languages: Czech, German

## History
Václav Kukačka senior left his employer around 1990 and started in a garage building trailers. Metalwork followed (gates, fences), then a first manual lathe and mill, then sheet pressing, including work for ETA (Austria), which financed automatic lathes. The first CNC machine was learned without a course, by trial and error. Around 2000 his son, also Václav, took over step by step, brought in new customers and built the shop up to what it is today.

## Services
### CNC turning
Rotational parts such as shafts, pins and bushings.
- Machines: Doosan Lynx 220 (2x), Goodway GLS-200, Goodway GLS-150, all with Fanuc control
- Maximum size: Ø 400 mm, length 600 mm
- Tolerance: ±0.01 mm

### CNC milling
3-axis milling from drawings or 3D models, prototypes to series.
- Machines: XHS machining centre (travel 800×500×500 mm), Robodrill (travel 700×400×330 mm), both Fanuc
- Tolerance: ±0.01 mm

### Material cutting
- Machines: Bianco band saws (2x)
- Bars and profiles up to Ø 260 mm, automatic feed, angled cuts

### Surface treatment and welding
Zinc plating, welding and other surface treatments organised through vetted partners, so the customer receives a finished part.

## Materials
Steel, stainless steel (for example 17 240 / 1.4301), aluminium (for example EN AW 6060), brass and technical plastics such as POM, PA6 and PTFE.

## How an order works
1. Send a drawing (PDF, DXF or STEP) with material and quantity through the form on the contact page.
2. A quotation with price and delivery date follows within 48 hours.
3. Production starts after approval, every part is measured before shipping.
4. Parts are shipped or handed over on the agreed day.

## Frequently asked questions
- Minimum order? One piece. Prototypes, single parts and repeat series.
- How fast is a quotation? Within 48 hours of receiving the drawing.
- Which materials? Steel, stainless steel, aluminium, brass, POM, PA6, PTFE.
- Which tolerances? Usually ±0.01 mm; tighter requirements are agreed per drawing.
- How large can parts be? Turning up to Ø 400 mm and 600 mm long, milling travel up to 800×500×500 mm, cutting up to Ø 260 mm.
- Surface treatment? Zinc plating, welding and other treatments through vetted partners.
- Customers abroad? Yes, regularly in Germany, Austria and Slovakia.
- What is needed for a quote? A PDF drawing with dimensions and tolerances, or a STEP model.
- Location and hours? Veselská 58, Dolní Bukovsko, Monday to Friday 07:00 to 16:00.

## References
Long-term supplier for Richmont (Czech Republic) and ETA (Austria), plus engineering companies in Germany and Slovakia.
